title: The Dagger
description: A stage dagger found under the berth. The blade is real - blood and hair on the edge. Its twin in the magicians' luggage is a harmless retractable prop.
hint: Ask anyone how Aldous was killed.

title: The Thread
description: A length of black magician's thread tied to the door bolt, trailing out through the window. It explains how the door could be 'locked from inside' by someone outside.
hint: Ask about the locked door or how the killer escaped.

title: The Conductor's Ledger
description: Amos Grey's ticket log: Sebastian Croft's berth in Car 5 was vacant from 1:25 to 1:45. Croft claimed he was in the dining car until 1:40.
hint: Ask Amos about tickets or anyone's alibi.

title: The Torn Queen
description: A Queen of Hearts with a torn corner, found under the berth. It matches the signature trick deck Sebastian uses - and a freshly torn Queen is tucked in his waistcoat.
hint: Ask Sebastian about cards or his act.

title: The Gala Humiliation
description: A 1921 press photo: Aldous on stage dismantling Sebastian's escape in three minutes. The caption reads 'CROFT'S CAREER DIES IN THREE MINUTES.' On the back, in Sebastian's hand: 'One day.'
hint: Ask Sebastian about his history with Aldous.

title: The Note
description: Retrieved from the floor of Sebastian's compartment: 'I know about Prague. Meet me in E at 1:30. - A.' The writing matches Aldous's hand.
hint: Ask Sebastian about any notes or messages.

title: The Drained Accounts
description: Henri's investment contract and bank statements: $2M in production funds moved to Aldous's private account over eight weeks. A photo shows Aldous with a false passport under the name 'Peter Arno.'
hint: Ask Henri about the tour money.

title: The Perfume & Handkerchief
description: A silk handkerchief monogrammed V.V. caught on the latch of compartment E, and the faint scent of Vivienne's signature perfume on the headrest. She claimed she never entered the room.
hint: Ask Vivienne whether she visited compartment E.

title: The Untouched Snow
description: Fresh snow against the window sill is undisturbed. No footprints on the roof or the track. Whoever opened that window either stayed aboard - or never needed to leave through it.
hint: Ask anyone how the killer could have escaped.

title: The Pocketed Stub
description: Found in Amos Grey's coat pocket: Sebastian Croft's ticket stub, punched at 1:32 in Car 7 - and hidden instead of logged. Amos says he planned to sell the information.
hint: Ask Amos if he found anything in the corridor.
